les: Wat in jou kos is en wat dit vir jou doen

items.bewering: Jou lyf haal elke dag stowwe uit die kos wat jy eet. Dit het hulle nodig om energie te kry, te groei en gesond te bly. Ons noem hierdie stowwe voedingstowwe.
items.bron: WHO, Healthy diet fact sheet (who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/healthy-diet): carbohydrates as the body's primary energy source, nutrients for healthy growth; WHO micronutrients topic page (vitamins and minerals needed for normal growth and development).

items.bewering: Nie alle kos gee jou dieselfde voedingstowwe nie. Daarom sorteer ons kos in vier voedselgroepe. Ons sorteer volgens die werk wat die kos in jou lyf doen en die belangrike voedingstof wat dit gee.
items.bron: DBE 2023/24 Annual Teaching Plan NST Gr 6, Term 1 (DBE document, schoolhive.co.za mirror): 'Classifying food into the different food groups, namely carbohydrates, proteins, fats and oils and vitamins and minerals' and 'State reasons why each food group is important in our diet'. This is the curriculum's classification convention (other systems group food differently); the lesson presents it as 'ons sorteer', which is accurate.

items.bewering: Koolhidrate is voedingstowwe wat jou lyf energie gee. Jy gebruik daardie energie om te loop, te speel en selfs om te dink. Suiker en stysel is albei koolhidrate.
items.bron: WHO Healthy diet fact sheet: 'Carbohydrates provide the primary energy source for the body'; Wikipedia 'Glucose': 'Glucose and oxygen supply almost all the energy for the brain'; Wikipedia 'Starch' (starch is the most common carbohydrate in human diets).

items.bewering: Jy het al geleer dat 'n plant glukose maak en dit as stysel stoor.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Glucose': produced by plants through photosynthesis and stored 'in plants mainly as amylose and amylopectin' (starch). Prior-learning claim: DBE Gr 6 ATP Term 1 places Photosynthesis (weeks 1-3, incl. comparing glucose and starch and the iodine starch test) before Nutrients in food (weeks 4-5).

items.bewering: Jou lyf kry energie uit die stysel in 'n aartappel of rys wanneer jy dit eet. Brood, mieliemeel, pasta en suiker is ook goeie bronne van koolhidrate.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Starch': starch is contained in large amounts in staple foods like potatoes, maize, rice and wheat (bread, pasta and maize meal are made from wheat and maize); sugar is itself a carbohydrate.

items.bewering: Proteïene is voedingstowwe vir groei en herstel. Jou lyf bou nuwe dele soos spiere en vel daarmee. Jou lyf bou nuwe vel met proteïen wanneer 'n sny aan jou knie gesond word.
items.blok: Proteïene: kos vir groei en herstel
items.bron: HMP Global Learning Network, 'How Dietary Protein and Collagen Dipeptides Improve Wound Healing': proteins provide the building blocks for tissue growth, cell renewal and repair throughout wound healing, including collagen formation and epidermal growth; collagen is a primary structural component of skin.

items.bewering: Eiers, vleis, vis en kaas is goeie bronne van proteïen. Boontjies kom van 'n plant af en gee ook baie proteïen.
items.blok: Proteïene: kos vir groei en herstel
items.bron: Harvard Health 'High-protein foods' and Harvard T.H. Chan Nutrition Source 'Protein': meat, fish, eggs and dairy including cheese are protein sources; beans, peas and lentils are among the better plant sources. Dry-bean data (small red beans ~23.5 g protein per 100 g).

items.bewering: Vette en olies gee jou lyf ook energie. Botter en margarien is vette en kookolie is 'n olie. 'n Olie is 'n vet wat by kamertemperatuur vloeibaar is.
items.blok: Vette en olies: energie vir later
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Fat': fats in the narrow sense are triglycerides solid or semisolid at room temperature, 'thus excluding oils', so oils are the liquid ones; butter and margarine are fat products. Energy: 'The Functions of Fats' (Nutrition: Science and Everyday Application, LibreTexts/Pressbooks) - fat gives about 9 kcal per gram against 4 for carbohydrate.

items.bewering: Jou lyf stoor ekstra energie as liggaamsvet vir later. Vet onder jou vel help ook om jou warm te hou en gee so isolasie.
items.blok: Vette en olies: energie vir later
items.bron: Cleveland Clinic 'Adipose Tissue (Body Fat)' and 'The Functions of Fats' (LibreTexts): body fat stores and releases energy; the layer of subcutaneous fat insulates the body from extreme temperatures.

items.bewering: Jou lyf gebruik vet ook om senuwees en organe te beskerm.
items.blok: Vette en olies: energie vir later
items.bron: Organs: Cleveland Clinic / 'The Functions of Fats' (LibreTexts) - fat cushions soft organs, visceral fat protects heart, kidneys and liver. Nerves: Britannica 'Myelin sheath' - myelin, the insulating and protective coating around nerve fibres, is about 70-80% lipid. Note for a human reader: the nerve half holds only with 'vet' in the broad sense of lipid (myelin lipids are mainly cholesterol and phospholipids, not storage fat like butter or body fat). At Grade 6 that is the ordinary sense of 'vet', so it is not marked contradicted.

items.bewering: Vitamiene en minerale is twee soorte voedingstowwe wat saam in een groep is. Saam help hulle om bene en tande te bou en jou immuunstelsel gesond te hou.
items.blok: Vitamiene en minerale: sterk bene en 'n gesonde lyf
items.bron: Grouping: DBE Gr 6 ATP Term 1 ('vitamins and minerals' as one food group). Functions: Dental Health Services Victoria 'Calcium, vitamin D and phosphorus' (bones and teeth); review 'Vitamins C, D and Zinc: Synergistic Roles in Immune Function and Infections' and PMC7750357 (vitamins C, D and zinc support normal immune function).

items.bewering: Jou immuunstelsel is die dele van jou lyf wat kieme beveg.
items.blok: Vitamiene en minerale: sterk bene en 'n gesonde lyf
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Immune system': 'a network of biological systems that protects an organism from diseases', responding to viruses, bacteria and parasites. Simplified but not false.

items.bewering: Kalsium is 'n mineraal wat bene en tande bou, en melk is 'n goeie bron daarvan.
items.blok: Vitamiene en minerale: sterk bene en 'n gesonde lyf
items.bron: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Calcium fact sheet: calcium makes up much of the structure of bones and teeth; dairy products are rich sources of calcium.

items.bewering: Vars vrugte en groente gee jou baie vitamiene en ook minerale.
items.blok: Vitamiene en minerale: sterk bene en 'n gesonde lyf
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Vegetable': vegetables 'are important sources of essential vitamins, minerals, and trace elements'; WHO Healthy diet fact sheet on fruit and vegetables.

items.bewering: Die meeste natuurlike kos bevat meer as een voedingstof.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Milk' and 'Vegetable' (each supplies several nutrients); dry-bean composition data (Nebraska Dry Bean Commission; US Dry Bean Council): protein, starch, fibre. Near single-nutrient foods (table sugar, cooking oil) are refined rather than 'natuurlik', so the quantifier holds.

items.bewering: Melk gee kalsium en ook proteïen en vet.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Milk': 'Milk contains many nutrients, including calcium and protein, as well as lactose and saturated fat'; 30-35 g protein and about 33 g fat per litre in full-fat milk.

items.bewering: Boontjies gee proteïen en ook baie stysel.
items.bron: Grand Forks Herald / dry-bean nutrition summaries (Nebraska Dry Bean Commission): 60-65% of the calories in dry beans come from carbohydrates, predominantly starch; beans are also a notable protein source.

items.bewering: Ons sorteer 'n kos dus in die groep van 'n belangrike voedingstof waarvoor dit 'n goeie bron is. Dit beteken nie dat die kos net daardie een voedingstof bevat nie.
items.bron: DBE Gr 6 ATP Term 1 classification task; consistent with the milk and bean composition data above.

items.bewering: Baie kos word in 'n fabriek gemaak en verpak. Dit is een soort verwerkte voedsel.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Food processing': the transformation of agricultural products into food or of one form of food into another; factory manufacture is one kind, cooking and drying are others.

items.bewering: Die fabriek voeg dikwels een of meer van vyf stowwe by: sout, suiker, preserveermiddels, geurmiddels en kleursel.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Food additive' and 'Food processing': salt, sugar, preservatives, flavourings and colours are all common additions. Note for a human reader: true as worded ('dikwels een of meer van'), but 'vyf stowwe' can read as a closed list. Factories also add other additives (the same article lists further categories) and, in South Africa by law since 2003, vitamins, iron and zinc to maize meal and bread flour (Department of Health fortification regulation, reported by NutraIngredients and BakeryAndSnacks, October 2003; PubMed 26385952). Mieliemeel is named earlier in this lesson. Not false, so not contradicted.

items.bewering: Sout en suiker gee smaak en help ook dat party kos langer hou.
items.bron: Scientific American, 'How do salt and sugar prevent microbial spoilage?' and UC ANR 'Water Activity and its Role in Food Preservation': salt and sugar lower water activity and inhibit microbes (curing, jams); Wikipedia 'Food processing': salt 'is added to prevent spoilage, add flavor'.

items.bewering: Preserveermiddels laat kos langer hou voordat dit bederf. Geurmiddels gee smaak of maak die smaak sterker. Kleursel gee die kos kleur.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Food additive': preservatives 'prevent or inhibit spoilage'; flavourings 'give food a particular taste or smell' and flavour enhancers 'enhance a food's existing flavors'; colours are added to replace lost colour or make food look more attractive.

items.bewering: Die etiket op 'n pak wys wat in die kos is. Soek eers die lys van bestanddele. Dit wys alles wat in die kos gesit is, ook die bygevoegde stowwe.
items.bron: South African Regulation R146 of 2010 on labelling of foodstuffs (Georgetown Global Food Laws record; SGS Safeguards 043/12; Food For Mzansi 'The fine print'): prepacked food carries a list of ingredients, additives included. Narrow legal exemptions exist but are below Grade 6 resolution.

items.bewering: Die lys begin by wat die meeste in die kos is en eindig gewoonlik by wat die minste is.
items.bron: R146 as summarised by SGS Safeguards 043/12 and Food For Mzansi: ingredients listed in descending order of mass, heaviest first and lightest last. 'gewoonlik' is a safe hedge.

items.bewering: Suiker heel voor op die lys beteken daar is meer suiker in as enigiets anders.
items.bron: R146 descending-order-of-mass rule (SGS Safeguards 043/12; Food For Mzansi): the first-listed ingredient weighs the most.

items.bewering: Baie pakke het ook 'n voedingstabel. Dit wys hoeveel energie, proteïen, koolhidraat en vet in die kos is.
items.bron: R146 regulation 50 (ASC Food Safety 'What R146 actually requires'; SGS Safeguards 043/12): the 'Typical nutritional information' table gives energy, protein, carbohydrate, fat and more. It is not compulsory on all prepacked food, so 'Baie pakke' is correctly hedged.

items.bewering: Pakke kom egter in verskillende groottes. Kyk daarom na die kolom 'per 100 g' of 'per 100 ml' en meet so albei pakke met dieselfde maat.
items.bron: R146 regulation 50 (SGS Safeguards 043/12): values expressed per single serving and per 100 g for solid foods or per 100 ml for liquids.

items.bewering: voedingstof: 'n Stof wat 'n lewende ding nodig het om te groei en gesond te bly. Party voedingstowwe in kos gee ook energie.
items.bron: WHO Healthy diet fact sheet and micronutrients page: carbohydrates (and fats) supply energy; vitamins and minerals are needed for growth and health without being energy sources - hence 'party' is correct.

items.bewering: koolhidraat: 'n Voedingstof, soos suiker of stysel, wat die liggaam energie gee.
items.bron: WHO Healthy diet fact sheet ('Carbohydrates provide the primary energy source for the body'); Wikipedia 'Starch'.

items.bewering: proteïen: 'n Voedingstof wat die liggaam gebruik om sy dele te bou en te herstel.
items.bron: HMP Global wound-healing article: protein as the building blocks for tissue growth and repair; Harvard Nutrition Source 'Protein'.

items.bewering: vitamien: 'n Voedingstof wat die liggaam in klein hoeveelhede nodig het om gesond te bly.
items.bron: WHO micronutrients topic page: 'Micronutrients are vitamins and minerals needed by the body in very small amounts'.

items.bewering: mineraal: 'n Voedingstof soos kalsium wat die liggaam in klein hoeveelhede nodig het.
items.bron: WHO micronutrients topic page (minerals are needed in small amounts). Calcium is the most abundant mineral in the body (NIH ODS Calcium fact sheet) and counts as a 'major' mineral, but the daily need is still small beside carbohydrate, protein or fat, so the example holds at Grade 6.

items.bewering: kalsium: 'n Mineraal wat die liggaam gebruik om bene en tande te bou.
items.bron: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Calcium fact sheet.

items.bewering: immuunstelsel: Die dele van die liggaam wat saamwerk om kieme te beveg.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Immune system': a network of biological systems protecting against viruses, bacteria and parasites.

items.bewering: isolasie: 'n Laag wat keer dat hitte maklik daardeur beweeg, in of uit.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Thermal insulation': 'the reduction of heat transfer' between objects of differing temperature, which works in either direction.

items.bewering: verwerkte voedsel: Kos wat mense verander het voordat ons dit eet, soos deur dit te kook, te droog of iets by te voeg.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Food processing': transformation of one form of food into another; cooking, drying and adding salt are all named as processing.

items.bewering: preserveermiddel: 'n Stof wat by kos gevoeg word sodat dit langer hou voordat dit bederf.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Food additive': preservatives 'prevent or inhibit spoilage of food'.

items.bewering: bestanddele: Al die dinge wat gebruik is om 'n kos te maak.
items.bron: R146 as summarised by Food For Mzansi and SGS Safeguards 043/12: the ingredient list names what the food is made from, additives included. Ordinary meaning of the word; no conflicting source found.

items.bewering: voedingstabel: 'n Tabel op 'n pak wat wys hoeveel energie en voedingstowwe in die kos is.
items.bron: R146 regulation 50 'Typical nutritional information' table (SGS Safeguards 043/12; ASC Food Safety guide).

opsomming: Alle bewerings bevestig; die les het geen eli10-vergelyking nie. Twee dinge verdien 'n moderator se blik al is nie een vals nie: die 'vyf stowwe' wat 'n fabriek byvoeg, kan soos 'n volledige lys lees, terwyl mieliemeel in Suid-Afrika by wet met vitamiene en minerale verryk word. En 'vet beskerm senuwees' is net waar as 'vet' breed bedoel word (die skede om senuwees bestaan meestal uit vetstowwe).
